svg.aria-label: msp-support-agent calls the read tool get_ticket on the servicedesk-read connection, without approval. API Management validates the technician's token and adds the correlation ID. The MCP server's read endpoint, /read/mcp on Azure Container Apps, checks the input against the tool's input schema and queries the Dataverse Web API on behalf of the signed-in technician. A structured result returns to the agent with ok true and the correlation_id. Failure path: a call with no ticket_number is rejected by the input schema with INVALID_ARGUMENT before anything reaches Dataverse, and a call for TCK-99999 returns TICKET_NOT_FOUND. Both errors are structured, with a code, a message and the correlation_id, and no stack trace. At the bottom, the redeploy loop of Task 3.4: edit the source in Visual Studio Code, build the image mcp-server:3.0.1 with az acr build, the Container App ca-mcp-123456 starts a new revision that reports 3.0.1 on /health, and if needed az containerapp revision copy rolls back to the previous revision.

svg.text: Key idea A bad call never reaches the agent as a crash: it gets a code, a message and a correlation ID it can act on, and nothing reaches Dataverse that the schema rejects.
